Featuring a 3.5-inch OCA fully laminated color display with a crisp 640×480 resolution, it delivers sharp visuals and vibrant colors for an immersive retro experience. The X6 Gaming Console is powered by a 32-bit RISC quad-core ATJ2273S processor, ensuring smooth performance across multiple preloaded emulators that support thousands of classic games. Its ergonomic dual 3D rockers with back L/R buttons provide precise control, while 32GB of built-in storage (expandable up to 64GB) ensures plenty of space for games and media. Beyond gaming, this X6 Handheld Gaming Console supports multimedia playback for videos, music, and images, making it a multifunctional entertainment device. A 2000mAh battery offers up to 6 hours of playtime, and with TV output and external controller ports, multiplayer sessions are easy and enjoyable. Compact, powerful, and nostalgic, the X6 Retro Handheld Gaming Console blends portability, classic gaming, and modern features into one stylish device.
